figures.finding: State money for film in Belarus goes to the state film organisations that produce films: Decree No. 275 of 31 August 2023 directs the republican budget to them for equipment and fixed assets; the Code on Culture (2016, in force 3 February 2017) took in the former Law on Cinematography. No open selective fund for independent producers was found.

value.body: Ministry of Culture / state film organisations (e.g. Belarusfilm)
